appraisal.label: frustration
appraisal.cause: The wizard tries to loot mid-fight.

improv_read.player_bid: Nik lets them go and checks the table.
improv_read.connection: The fight is still on; nobody has fled.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit corrects the premise in the fiction and keeps the fight live.

public_brief.objective: Make the attacker pay for the burn instead of letting him loot.
public_brief.tactic: Refuse to flee and close in with the crew.
public_brief.visible_cue: Three pale figures edge closer between him and the table.
public_brief.reply_to: I let them go and check the table.
public_brief.kit_focus: Show that no one fled and the table is still out of reach, then call for initiative.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: keep the threat close and physical

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Nobody is running. The table stands upright with its coins and a silver ring still stacked on it, cards scattered across the floor around it. The burned dealer has backed against the carved wall, and the three other pale figures are on their feet between Nik and the table, fists up, edging closer.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Let us go? Generous, little rabbit, when you have just set my face on fire! No one here is going anywhere until you have paid for that, in gold or in teeth!

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: They're coming at you, not running. Roll initiative.
segments.reacts_to: No one here is going anywhere
